verdictStatement: CONSENT. Zero MUST-FIX, zero SHOULD-FIX. The subject was attacked on subject custody, turn delta and scope creep, landed-finding fidelity for both CODEX-D295-SF1 and CLAUDE-D295-T2-SF1, completeness and currency of all twelve cross-lineage citations under D-294, residual stale tokens, the 42-site and byte-identity recitals measured independently of v10's own assertions, obligation naming, identifier invention, grade-ruling overreach, status-token flattening, the no-cell-edit branch, predecessor standing for v6 through v9, and every readiness number. Every attack was repelled. Four uncounted advisories are recorded for a later successor's benefit and request no change to these bytes. The four advisory identifiers are this review's own; no other party's identifier is invented anywhere in this file.
